data.credibility: Management consistently raises or delivers on guidance, as seen in FY26 targets. However, they occasionally drop long-term commitments like the 75% shareholder return target by failing to mention it in subsequent quarters.

lines.line: Guided 4%-5% services growth, raised in Q3, and delivered for full-year FY26.
Guided 3%-5% company growth, raised in Q3, and delivered in Q4.
Guided 17%-18% EBIT margin, delivered an actual 20.5% in FY26.
Guided FY27 revenue growth at 1% to 4%, currently on track.
Guided FY27 services revenue growth at 1.5% to 4.5%, currently on track.
Guided FY27 EBIT margin of 17.5%-18.5%, tracking at 20.4% so far.
Committed to return 75% net income to shareholders over 5 years, but dropped.

overrides.reason: Ledger status is correctly marked as dropped because the commitment was not mentioned in Q1 or Q2 FY27.

bull: Operating cash flow reached 127% of reported profit over five years, showing strong cash conversion backed by net worth of ₹76,092 cr.
Solid deal momentum with $9.3 billion in net new contract value wins recorded in FY26.
Healthy balance sheet with borrowings of ₹6,013 cr against net worth of ₹76,092 cr, resulting in a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.08.
bear: Growth is slowing down, with revenue compounding at 8.7% annually over three years compared to 11.5% over five years.
EBITDA margin has narrowed significantly from 26.6% in FY21 down to 20.6% in FY26.
Management dropped its multi-year shareholder return commitment of at least 75% of net income after failing to mention it in subsequent quarters.
